dedupe_keys.name: energydetective 2020 dataset hourly energy of shanghai office buildings for prediction without history

description: This dataset was used in EnergyDetective 2020, a competition run by the Xu Peng Research Group on predicting a building's energy consumption from physical information without its own historical data. It was published on Zenodo (version of 29 May 2022) by Tong Xiao, Peng Xu, Huajing Sha and Jiefan Gu of Tongji University and Zhe Chen of Texas A&M University. It has a test building set with more physical description and a reference building set with more historical consumption, all hourly from office buildings in Shanghai from 2015 to 2017, split into lighting and plug loads (Q) and HVAC (W), with weather from a Shanghai station; the new version adds history for the test buildings. Coverage: office buildings in Shanghai. Access: one 26 MB zip on Zenodo, with the competition on GitHub. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: raw meter data came from a private dataset of an energy management company. Simulation uses: benchmarking energy prediction for buildings without history, such as new or unmetered buildings. Related records: BuildingsBench and the ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor data.
